nodes.name: Pt single atoms in sodalite cages
Pyrolysis of ferritin@ZIF-8 for Fe SACs
nodes.procedure: Liang et al. encapsulated ferritin in ZIF-8 via a biomineralization method. The N-coordinated number of the isolated Fe can be regulated by optimizing the type of precursors and the temperature of pyrolysis during preparation: Fe-N4 obtained by pyrolysis of ferritin@ZIF-8 under 800°C; Fe-N3 obtained with FeCl3@ZIF-8 under 800°C; Fe-N2 obtained with ferritin@ZIF-8 at 950°C.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of Rh SACs
nodes.procedure: Sun et al. used [Rh(NH2CH2CH2NH2)3]Cl3 complex as the precursor via a hydrothermal method to prepare single-atom Rh catalysts, in which Rh atoms are located within sinusoidal 5-membered rings of MFI-type silicalite-1 and stabilized by oxygen atoms of ZSM-5 zeolites.
nodes.source_text: Sun et al. have demonstrated... used [Rh(NH2CH2CH2NH2)3]Cl3 complex as the precursor via a hydrothermal method to prepare single-atom Rh catalysts

nodes.name: Selective encaging of Pt atoms
nodes.procedure: Chen et al. developed a unique strategy for selectively encaging metal single atoms in specific cages of zeolites. The template molecules of choline chloride were employed to occupy the space of supercages in Y zeolites, while Pt atoms with specific coordination were encapsulated into the remaining sodalite cages in Y zeolites.
nodes.source_text: Chen et al. developed a unique strategy for selectively encaging metal single atoms... choline chloride were employed to occupy the space of supercages in Y zeolites

nodes.name: Two-step pyrolysis for Cu SAC
nodes.procedure: Wang et al. pyrolyzed ZIF-8 at 920°C and treated it with 3M HCl to obtain NC with porous structure. Then, sodium dicyandiamide and melamine as N-resource was blended with the mixture of NC and Cu ions to synthesize Cu SAC under a second pyrolysis for excellent antibacterial effects.
